{{Quote|Ever since the XP-38 came out, they just aren't in demand.|[[Luke Skywalker]], after selling his X-34 landspeeder|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The '''XP-38 sport speeder''' was a [[landspeeder]] that was popular on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. The proliferation of this model decreased the sale value of older models of landspeeders. The vehicle shares many similarities in design with the [[X-34 landspeeder]], but it has a closed cockpit and bulkier turbine engines.<ref name="Land, Sea and Air Speeders" />
